info.title: FeraCal CalDAV adapter
info.summary: Complete CalDAV discovery, reporting, retrieval, conditional write, and deletion contract
info.description: Source-traced FeraCal CalDAV adapter contract covering all callable registrations, Basic credential verification, DAV discovery headers, Depth, XML multistatus/report formats, RFC 5545 iCalendar, ETags, and conditional mutation.

tags.name: DAV
tags.description: DAV method discovery and authenticated collection probes.

tags.name: Discovery
tags.description: Principal, home, and calendar PROPFIND discovery.

tags.name: Reports
tags.description: CalDAV query, multiget, and sync reports.

tags.name: Events
tags.description: iCalendar event resources and conditional mutations.

basicAuth.description: CalDAV username and password verified through FeraAuth with instance or calendar context; verification also resolves principal read/write capabilities.

success.description: Indicates that the DAV request failed.

message.description: Safe protocol, authorization, resource, or dependency failure message.

details.x-additionalProperties-reason: Non-production diagnostic fields vary with the originating parser or downstream dependency.
details.description: Development-only diagnostic details when present. Production responses omit dependency internals.

error.description: Structured safe CalDAV failure returned to the protocol client.

success.description: Indicates that the adapter process is running.

get.description: Returns 200 when the service process is running. This probe does not access the database, external services, configuration, secrets, or internal error details.

200.description: The service is healthy for this probe.

get.description: Returns 200 only when critical service dependencies pass bounded read-only checks. Returns 503 during dependency failure or graceful termination and never creates, migrates, or changes data.

200.description: The service is healthy for this probe.

503.description: The service is not ready to receive traffic.

get.description: Compatibility endpoint retained for existing callers. It maps to the service readiness contract and returns 503 during dependency failure or graceful termination.

503.description: The service is not ready to receive traffic.

x-feradel-status-matrix.condition: A critical dependency is unavailable or the service is draining.
x-feradel-status-matrix.developerAction: Retry after the dependency recovers or the service completes its deployment transition.

x-feradel-access.authorization: No credentials or calendar capability are required; the operation exposes only process liveness or static DAV method/compliance metadata.
x-feradel-access.licensing: No product-license check is performed because the operation does not access tenant calendar state.
x-feradel-access.instanceContext: No instance or calendar owner context is resolved for this public operation.
x-feradel-access.ownership: The response contains no principal, calendar, event, or tenant-owned data.

x-feradel-access.authorization: HTTP Basic credentials are verified by FeraAuth and the resolved principal must have read capability for the selected calendar context.
x-feradel-access.licensing: The adapter has no separate local product-license middleware; it relies on FeraAuth credential verification and FeraCal calendar-access resolution for the effective instance.
x-feradel-access.instanceContext: Principal and instance routes supply an instance UUID. Calendar routes first resolve the calendar UUID to its owner instance, then verify credentials in that effective context.
x-feradel-access.ownership: The verified FeraAuth user is resolved to a FeraCal person and calendar role; collection and event access is constrained to calendars for which that principal has the required capability.
